_comment: Which harness mode ids (and config option values) skip every approval, for sessions.allowFullAccess. acpmux (hub/start_mode.rs) and the cmux NEXT app (AgentPaneModeConfirmation.swift, checked by FullAccessModeRuleTests) both apply this rule: lowercase the id, drop every '-', '_' and space, then it is full access when it contains any marker.
